newsitem.title: NICARAGUA: Nicaragua bank chief predicts economic take-off.
newsitem.headline: Nicaragua bank chief predicts economic take-off.

text.p: Nicaragua's annual gross domestic product of about $2 billion will grow by at least 5.5 percent in 1996 and from 6.5 percent to 7.0 percent in 1997, Nicaraguan Central Bank President Jose Evenor Taboada said on Tuesday.

Taboada painted a rosy picture of the Nicaraguan economy after the six years of deep structural reforms carried out by the centrist, free-market government of President Violeta Chamorro, who was voted to power in 1990, ending nearly 11 years of Marxist Sandinista government.
